title: Symmetric int8 quantization
summary: Absmax int8 quantization with one scale per tensor and one scale per row, with dequantization and a zero-row rule.

mutants.columns_not_rows: Takes the maximum over axis 0, so it gives one scale for each column, not for each row.
mutants.max_not_absmax: Uses the maximum of the values, not of their magnitudes, for the per-tensor scale.
mutants.round_half_up: Rounds with floor(x + 0.5), so values that are exactly halfway round up and not to the even integer.
mutants.scale_by_128: Divides the maximum by 128, not by 127.
mutants.truncate_per_row: Casts the per-row values to int8 without a round and without a clip, so the fraction is cut off.
mutants.zero_row_divides: Has no rule for a row of zeros, so 0 / 0 gives NaN.
